notes.title: Prism confirmed at E3 2016
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/fec9bede5dfe9f8b165c526b935c57e1ad0e0d4b.png

Prism gonna be present at E3 2016, June 14-16 on the stand of Budgames.

Our stand number will be 2903.

Our participation for the the E3 will be really an important moment for us and we hope to see many of you on our stand to live this great event together.

A playable demo will be available there so don't hesitate to come say hi!

see you next week in L.A

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/db5baedbcbab59141298913b7bdea7fb1ea7ed98.jpg

notes.title: Back from Stunfest
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/2710667673c6dd65d1cfb90d194c7ff4f9ccc385.png


Last week we were presenting the last build of Prism at Rennes for the Stunfest festival for its 12th edition!

So many amazing feedback this year again, and we want to say Thank You, to all people who came giving a try to our game.

We were also really suprised, but we won the 2nd place of the Great Audience Award of between the 39 other indie games who were present with us.

finally, we also gave an interview (in French) to Joypad, you can read it here


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/073a45dacb49ba5b92d2495f9ce61dd9a09d15d7.jpg

Joypad - interview with the developers

Now, we are engaging the next step of the production, and we will start soon to work on new levels, and enemies.

Stay tunned ! 

Bonus : some pictures
